judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The 'LEIA MAIS' link (to /fundacao/quem-somos/, 'Quem somos') sits right under the h2 'A Fundação' and its paragraph about the Foundation. By this round's context rule the preceding heading counts, and 'LEIA MAIS' with 'A Fundação' tells users the link leads to more about the Foundation, which is what the destination is; no other link shares the name. So the claim that nothing around it gives the purpose is false of the capture and the link meets 2.4.4. The model had the heading and judged wrongly. Separately, the button's white text on #ffb700 (about 1.75:1) fails 1.4.3. The live page fetched on 2026-11-25 has the same markup, and the screenshot is fully styled (Signika font, the theme's colours), so the capture matches what users receive.
